description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for HDMI CEC Sink plugin, including event handling, device management, and JSONRPC wrappers within WPEFramework.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkFrameListener
classes.description: Listens for HDMI CEC frames and notifies the processor.

classes.name: HdmiCecSinkProcessor
classes.description: Processes various HDMI CEC messages and manages connection state.

classes.name: CECDeviceParams
classes.description: Holds parameters and state information for a CEC device.

classes.name: HdmiCecSink
classes.description: Main plugin class managing HDMI CEC sink functionality, device list, and JSONRPC interfaces.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notify method for frame listener to handle incoming CEC frames.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Various overloaded methods to process specific CEC messages.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets device parameters to default state.

methods.name: isAllUpdated
methods.description: Checks if all device parameters are updated.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates specific device parameters and flags.

methods.name: HdmiCecSink
methods.description: Constructor for the main plugin class.

methods.name: ~HdmiCecSink
methods.description: Destructor for the main plugin class.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to enable or disable CEC.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get CEC enabled status.

methods.name: setActivePathWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set active HDMI path.
